Bears failing_passing rows are still preflight only until command output, checkout lineage, and same-source patch-verifier causality pass.

open_swe_import_artifact.priority_contract: Python bug-fix traces, 1-3 changed paths, <=80 modified lines, selected test present, failure+pass markers present; still zero admission.
